Def.Content: avoid answering or seeming to heed by speaking off the topic, or pretend to be doing s.t. else in order to avoid the embarrassment of a confrontation.

Examples.Phrase: Ayaw paalibagbag ug basabása myintras gisultíhan ka nákù,
Examples.Gloss: Don’t sit there reading while I am talking to you.

Examples.Phrase: Gialibagbágan (gipaalibagbágan) ku níyag tubag kay dì man siya muadmitir nákù,
Examples.Gloss: He answered me off the topic to avoid admitting it.
